#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, max_len = 0, countw = 0;
    string x;
    cin >> n >> x;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (x[i] != '_' && x[i] != '(') {
            int count = 0;
            for (int j = i; j < n; ++j) {
                if (x[j] != '_' && x[j] != '(') ++count;
                if (x[j] == '_' || x[j] == '(' || j == n - 1) {
                    max_len = max(max_len, count);
                    i = j;
                    count = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (x[i] == '(') {
            int count = 0;
            for (int j = i; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((x[j] == '_' || x[j] == ')') && count > 0) {
                    ++countw;
                    count = 0;
                }
                if (x[j] == ')') {
                    i = j;
                    break;
                }
                if (x[j] != '_' && x[j] != '(') ++count;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << max_len << " " << countw << endl;
    return 0;
}
